why: T47 (SA-27): _decoded_smiles_stats used a hand-written 5-element metal set that OMITTED Pt, while _TARGET_METALS includes it. A Pt-only decode scored decode_metal_ratio 0.0, and wf_a53_eval_cfm_test_split re-published that number under the bare name metal_ratio.
code_change: the returned dict gains decode_metal_cohort so the set travels with the number
reading: Both shipped pools are ~10.7% Pt by row, and every one of those rows was counted as metal-free. The metric did not report 0 overall because the cohort mixes metals; it reported 0 for the metal the project is named after, which is invisible in the aggregate.
honest_limits: The before/after numbers are recomputed from the shipped SMILES with both element sets. They are not a re-run of wf_a53.
No archived artifact is rewritten; any table quoting metal_ratio from before this commit is quoting the 5-element definition.
